meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在处理查代码、改一两处文件、检查代码改动这类任务时，会先派给三个专门的子代理。这些子代理返回简短的结果，因此每轮任务占用的对话上下文更少。
howto.when: 当你要求定位代码、做 1~2 个文件的精确修改、或审查代码 diff 时，Claude 会改用对应的子代理来处理；大范围重构或需要完整分析时不会用。

say.text: 帮我找一下 `login` 函数在哪里定义、谁在调用。
say.note: 会派 investigator 定位并返回精简结果。

say.text: 把 `utils.py` 第 15 行的变量名改成 `count`。
say.note: 交给 builder 做精确的小修改。

say.text: 审查刚提交的代码改动，列出问题。
say.note: 调用 reviewer 审查 diff，只返回问题清单。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude delegates code-locating, small (1-2 file) edits, and diff review to three dedicated subagents. Their compressed output saves main-context space on every delegation.
howto.when_en: Use these subagents when the task is locating code (definitions, callers), making a surgical edit of 1–2 files, or reviewing a diff/branch for bugs; skip them for big refactors or prose-style analysis.

say_en.text: Find where the `login` function is defined and who calls it.
say_en.note: Delegates to investigator and returns a compact list.

say_en.text: Rename the variable on line 15 of utils.py to `count`.
say_en.note: Handed to builder for a precise small edit.

say_en.text: Review the latest code changes and list issues.
say_en.note: Reviewer audits the diff and reports findings only.
